verification_rules.canonicalization: UTF-8, LF, sorted object keys, no trailing whitespace

artifact_registry.description: Pointers only. Actual artifacts live in AL / JOY / COMPUTERWISDOM / HEIDEE.

jurisdiction_packs.description: Overlays only. Never rewrite source bytes.
jurisdiction_packs.rule: SOURCE_ARTIFACT.sha256 stays primary; jurisdiction metadata is a separate leaf that references source_sha256

language_packs.description: Translations are derived artifacts with their own hash + source_sha256 pointer.
language_packs.rule: SOURCE_ARTIFACT.sha256 = A; TRANSLATION.sha256 = B; TRANSLATION.source_sha256 = A

revocation_and_withdrawal_log.description: Append-only status changes. Original claim leaf never deleted.
